suggestions.label: Button hover
suggestions.why: This is the page's main button, so it should answer the pointer quickly.

suggestions.label: Hero entrance
suggestions.why: This is the first thing people read on the page, so it can arrive as the page opens.

suggestions.label: Card hover
suggestions.why: There are 3 cards like this one, so one lift carries across all of them and shows which card the pointer is on.

suggestions.label: Navigation hover
suggestions.why: These are the page's main links, and a line under the one the pointer is on shows where it goes.

suggestions.label: Image reveal
suggestions.why: This is a large image below the first screen, so it can open as it scrolls into view.
